reason: I already confirm the mobile-money SMS and send the PDF by hand on WhatsApp; with Maketia I still confirm each payment and send the link myself, so I'd pay 9 900 a month to do the same work. At most I'd try the free page, and I'd have to open a SasPay account first.

would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation and delivery actually working, so the buyer gets the file without me touching my phone.
